hero.title: Ending Pandemics
hero.subtitle: The protracted outbreak of Ebola in West Africa in 2014-2015, many times larger than prior outbreaks, has revealed the inadequacies of traditional methods for combatting pandemics focused at the individual level. Research conducted at the NECSI has demonstrated community level interventions and targeted travel restrictions or monitoring of travelers are much more effective.

contentBlocks.heading: In the era of global connectivity, it is easier than ever for epidemics to spiral into pandemics. NECSI analysis shows how best to contain them.
